generic_domain.justification: Normalizing Flows is a broad category that includes Continuous Normalizing Flows as one of its subdomains. Continuous Normalizing Flows are a specific type of flow-based models that use continuous transformations to model complex data distributions. Since normalizing flows encompass various types of flow architectures, including but not limited to residual flows, coupling layers, and continuous-time flows, it serves as the more general domain that can include other specialized areas like continuous normalizing flows.
